tableNames.Name: Wheel tables
tableNames.Hint: Comma-separated names of roll tables (case-insensitive) that spin the wheel when drawn. The table this module creates uses the wheel whatever its name, unless you switch it off; use the Wheel button on a table's sheet to force any table on or off.

audience.Name: Who sees the wheel
audience.Hint: Who gets the wheel window for public rolls. GM, blind and self rolls always limit it to the people allowed to see the result.

spinSeconds.Name: Spin length (seconds)
spinSeconds.Hint: How long the wheel spins before it lands. Fake-outs add a couple of seconds.

fakeOuts.Name: Fake-outs
fakeOuts.Hint: Sometimes the wheel stops, then creeps forward or rolls back a slice. The landing result is never changed.

commentary.Name: System AI commentary
commentary.Hint: The System AI's running commentary and lines about the result, achievements, reward boxes, sponsors, audience reactions and surge check jokes. Off: plain wording instead. Notifications, the wild magic window title and the game-show look (LIVE badge, viewers, verdict plate) keep their flavour.

autoCreateTable.Name: Create the table automatically
autoCreateTable.Hint: On first load, create a Wild Magic Surge roll table if the world has none. It only happens once, so a table you delete stays deleted; use the Create the Wild Magic Surge table button for a fresh one.

tableCreated.Name: Wild Magic Surge table created
tableCreated.Hint: Internal: the table has been created once.

surgeCheck.Name: Surge check (dnd5e)
surgeCheck.Hint: After a creature with the surge feature casts a spell of 1st level or higher, roll a d20; on a 1, spin the wheel. Ignored while Wild Magic Surge 5e is active.

Choices.auto: Auto: roll a d20 after each spell

surgeFeatureName.Name: Surge feature name
surgeFeatureName.Hint: The name of the feature (case-insensitive) that makes a creature check for surges.

wmsIntegration.Name: Wild Magic Surge 5e integration
wmsIntegration.Hint: Only used when Wild Magic Surge 5e is active. Intercept: cancel that module's table card and spin the wheel for the same result. Hook: when it reports a surge, roll the table named in its Roll Table Name setting (else this module's table) and spin (set its Auto Roll Table option to None). Off: leave that module alone.

Choices.hook: Hook: react to its surge hook

sound.Name: Sound
sound.Hint: Ticks, drumrolls and landing stingers on this device.

volume.Name: Volume
volume.Hint: Volume of the wheel sounds, scaled by the interface volume.

autoCloseSeconds.Name: Auto-close (seconds)
autoCloseSeconds.Hint: Close the wheel window this many seconds after it lands. 0 keeps it open until you close it.

skipWheel.Name: Coward Mode: skip the wheel
skipWheel.Hint: Don't open the wheel window on this device when someone rolls (Instant Replay still opens it). Results still arrive in chat, with judgement.

history.Name: Recent results
history.Hint: Internal: recent results on this device, used for repeat and streak commentary.

CreateTable.Name: Wild Magic Surge table
CreateTable.Label: Create the Wild Magic Surge table
CreateTable.Hint: Create a new world roll table with all 50 Wild Magic Surge results, set up for the wheel and rollable by players.
CreateTable.ConfirmTitle: Create the Wild Magic Surge table
CreateTable.ConfirmContent: Create a new Wild Magic Surge roll table? Existing tables are not changed.

Notifications.NoTable: No Wild Magic Surge roll table was found.
Notifications.TableCreated: Created the Wild Magic Surge roll table.
Notifications.CreateFailed: Could not create the Wild Magic Surge roll table. See the console for details.
Notifications.GMOnly: Only a GM can do that.
Notifications.NoReplay: There is no wheel to replay for that message.
Notifications.ReplayHidden: You are not allowed to see that result.
Notifications.DrawnUpdateFailed: Could not mark the drawn results of {name}. Ask a GM to reset the table if it repeats results.
Notifications.ToggleFailed: Could not change the wheel setting of this table.
